name: Stock Video Footage (Shutterstock / Pond5)

yield.notes: Per-clip earnings vary widely by platform and exclusivity. Contributors earn $0.25-$150 per license.

flags: Shutterstock contributor earnings have declined over past 5 years
AI-generated video policies vary and are evolving rapidly

prerequisites: Camera/drone or AI video generation tool (Runway, Pika, Kling)
startup_checklist: Choose approach: real footage (higher quality, slower) or AI video (faster, policy risks)
Research top-selling stock footage categories (business, nature, technology, lifestyle)
Upload to Shutterstock, Pond5, and Adobe Stock (non-exclusive to maximize reach)
Track which clips sell and double down on those categories
failure_modes: AI video detected and rejected by platform
sources_note: Earnings data from contributor community forums.
